candidates.name: GzmCR / Kaggriculture

smoke.notes: Import OK, valid action dict, 720-step game completes DONE/DONE. Scenario-based crop/animal mix with cash-reserve logic.

candidates.rationale: Clean stateless design with explicit scenario branches (core/mid/target herd, crop mix, land expansion calendar). Economic policy layer is complementary to v11E's tape+repair approach.

candidates.name: asajjadi / kaggriculture

smoke.notes: Import OK, valid action dict, 720-step game completes DONE/DONE. Lower smoke score but robust.

candidates.rationale: Stateless diversified greedy with per-unit task assignment and market-aware batch selling. ROI gate on hires/land/animals provides natural economic braking.

candidates.name: Seyamalam / Kaggriculture V21
candidates.type: tape + router + closed-loop market + capital latch
candidates.claimed: Live rating 2053.6 (V18 open 24-3), V21 100/110 wins vs frozen V18 corpus
candidates.rationale: The 2053.6 agent is real and executable in our environment. However, 8-game head-to-head vs local v11E shows v11E winning 5-3 with +3879 avg margin. Claims appear context-dependent (earlier competition phase or different opponent pool).

candidates.name: COK-ZhangZiliang / Kaggriculture V10
candidates.rationale: Executable but clearly outclassed by v11E in 8-game benchmark. Tape+repair architecture is well-understood and already present in v11E.

candidates.name: gytdrop / KaggricultureAgent v5
candidates.type: mined heuristic (no tapes, no learned weights)
candidates.rationale: Executable but lost 6-2 to v11E. Architecture is simple mined heuristics without tape replay, which limits ceiling against strong opponents.
